versions.description_html:
Learn what Microsoft Foundry Agent Service is, how it works with AI models and tools, and how to build production-ready agents without server headaches.

Microsoft's Foundry catalog now holds more than ten thousand AI models. That number only matters if you can turn a model into something that actually does work.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What an AI agent actually is
  • What Microsoft Foundry Agent Service is
  • Models, the brain you can swap
  • Tools and knowledge, how agents take action
  • Threads, runs, conversations, and responses
  • Hosting and scaling, where the agent lives
  • Safety, identity, and evaluation
  • How it relates to Copilot Studio
  • What people actually build with it
  • Recap and one question for you

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Prevent Shadow IT in Microsoft Foundry AI Agent Programs
  • AI Agent Identity Security: Beyond Service Accounts
  • More AI & Copilot episodes on M365.FM
